reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings for your InfluxDB v2.x / v3 server.
reconfigure.title: InfluxDB configuration

push_to_influxdb.name: Push recorder history to InfluxDB
push_to_influxdb.description: Queues selected entities and time ranges for the background history push worker. The current push implementation only logs its arguments.

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: Entity IDs to process, including ones excluded by filters or recorder.

entity_globs.name: Entity globs
entity_globs.description: Patterns for current entities. Matches excluded by Simple InfluxDB or recorder are skipped.

from.name: From
from.description: Later end of the time range. Use with back_until.

back_until.name: Back until
back_until.description: Earlier end of the time range. Must be before from.

from_days.name: From days
from_days.description: Alternative to from. 0 ends at tomorrow's midnight; 1 ends at today's midnight.

back_until_days.name: Back until days
back_until_days.description: Alternative to back_until. 0 starts at today's midnight; 1 starts at yesterday's midnight.

chunk_size.name: Chunk size
chunk_size.description: Maximum number of history records to handle per batch when copying is implemented.
